title: Maia 200: A Software Defined Dataflow System for Large-scale AI Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2608.24664v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Maia 200, an advanced AI accelerator delivering high performance-10 145 Tflop/s FP4 and 5072 Tflop/s FP8 within a 750W TDP and 7 TB/s HBM bandwidth. Maia exemplifies a new class of Software Defined Locally Accessed Dataflow Architectures (SDLA), which explicitly program dataflow engines to orchestrate highly specialized memories and data movement engines. This approach shifts the focus from today's thread-centric to data-movement-centric architecture, improving efficiency and scalability. Our taxonomy of data management, inspired by Flynn's classification, highlights how SDLA addresses challenges in modern AI computing. Maia 200 achieves significant cost and energy savings while supporting massive parallelism for AI inference workloads, making it a compelling solution for next-generation high-performance computing systems.

translated_title: Maia 200：一种用于大规模AI加速的软件定义数据流系统
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了Maia 200，一种先进的AI加速器，在750W热设计功耗和7 TB/s HBM带宽内提供高性能——FP4下达到10,145 Tflop/s，FP8下达到5,072 Tflop/s。Maia代表了新型软件定义本地访问数据流架构（SDLA）的典范，该架构显式编程数据流引擎，以编排高度专业化的内存和数据移动引擎。这种方法将焦点从当今以线程为中心转向以数据移动为中心的架构，提升了效率和可扩展性。我们受Flynn分类启发提出的数据管理分类法，突出了SDLA如何应对现代AI计算中的挑战。Maia 200在支持AI推理工作负载的大规模并行性的同时，实现了显著的成本和能源节省，使其成为下一代高性能计算系统的有力解决方案。
tldr: Maia 200通过软件定义的数据流架构，以数据移动为中心替代线程中心，在低功耗下实现超高性能，显著提升AI加速的效率和可扩展性。
en_tdlr: Maia 200 leverages a software-defined dataflow architecture, shifting from thread-centric to data-movement-centric design, to achieve ultra-high performance at low power, significantly improving efficiency and scalability for AI acceleration.
